instruction: I need to install Inkscape vector graphics editor on this system. Can you assist with the installation?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
